description: Queue one design turn that drafts or revises the study's discussion guide, questions, screener, and audience from the research brief. May fetch a researcher-provided concept URL. Clients that support MCP background tasks receive a task to wait on; other clients receive a job ID and poll get_customize_study_job. Then call get_study and show the full saved plan for human review. Reuse an idempotency_key after an uncertain response. Native concept images require the synchronous customize_study tool.

concept_image.description: Native images are only supported by customize_study.

decisions.description: Use agent only when the human delegated research design choices.

execution_policy.description: Control whether the study plan is a draft or should be reviewed before fieldwork.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

message.description: Research brief, requested revision, or answer to the previous design question.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

name: queue_customize_study
title: Queue Interview Guide Design
